decisions.reason: The availability-payment sizing criteria use equity IRR as a threshold but do not change the candidate's CCA method, classes, or modeled tax effects.
The DSCR and equity-IRR sizing thresholds do not alter the candidate's debt/equity structure, financing rate, tranche structure, or refinement trigger.
Operating expenditure remains an input to the model, but the availability-payment sizing decision does not change its amount, source, or applicability.
Capital expenditure may influence calculated returns, but the source decision does not change any capex estimate, assumption basis, or line-item treatment.
The availability-payment thresholds do not change the eight-site count, site list, or site-level modeling basis.

The candidate still validly compares a user-funded case with a PPP availability-payment case; the sizing criteria are independently owned by the source Requirement and do not change that scenario definition.
The sizing criteria do not alter the required integrated three-statement structure or the financial-engine basis.
The source decision establishes availability-payment sizing thresholds but does not add, remove, or change any sensitivity variable.
The obligation to document assumptions remains unchanged; the newly confirmed sizing values belong to the source Requirement rather than changing the traceability policy.
The availability-payment sizing decision does not change the requirement to reconcile source data or the designated reference-source hierarchy.
The source decision does not change the model currency or price base year.
The source decision does not change the modeled revenue streams, pricing assumption basis, or revenue-assumption documentation.
